articles.title: Vanguard opens search for digital assets leader in sign of evolving crypto strategy
articles.snippet: The new role would oversee tokenization, stablecoins and blockchain initiatives as Vanguard reassesses digital assets.

articles.title: Former Tether investment chief is looking to sell part of his stake in the stablecoin giant: Bloomberg
articles.snippet: Richard Heathcote is reportedly working with PJT Partners to find a buyer for a small part of his 1.26% holding in the issuer of USDT following his transition to an advisory role.

articles.title: Stablecoin-settled TradFi perpetual trading tops $1.1T: Binance Research
articles.snippet: A new Binance Research report said stablecoins are fast becoming a preferred settlement layer for tokenized TradFi markets while gaining traction in payments and savings.

articles.title: Kazakhstan president signs decree to accelerate crypto adoption
articles.snippet: Kazakhstan targets gas-powered electricity for mining, income tax exemptions for regulated crypto transactions and cross-border stablecoin payments in a new decree signed by the president.

articles.title: Mobile app Toss and blockchain Optimism to conduct Korean won stablecoin POC: report
articles.snippet: Toss has reportedly partnered with Optimism and Sunnyside Labs for a proof of concept on the feasibility of a Korean won-based stablecoin for payments.
